title: Notice of the Homeowner's Right to Cancel a Replacement System Installations Contract Signed at Home
content:
# Right to cancel a home solicitation sale — Replacement System Installations

## The right

A Replacement System Installations contract signed in an in-home consultation is a home solicitation sale, which the homeowner may cancel for a full refund within the statutory cancellation period.

## How a cancellation takes effect

Cancelling an installation contract is the homeowner's own decision: the agent records a cancellation request and the homeowner confirms it, and the cancellation takes effect when it is confirmed. A cancellation takes effect only once the homeowner has confirmed a cancellation request on the project.

## The cancellation period

**Clause.** The full-refund cancellation applies only when the homeowner gives notice of cancellation no later than the package's cancellation period (3 business days on every package) after the contract was signed.

- **Clock start:** the signing date of the contract, as recorded on the project.
- **Counting:** business days are every calendar day except Sundays and federal public holidays, counted from the day after the signing date.
- **Boundary:** notice received at any time through the end of the last such day is timely; the last day itself is inside the period.
- **Evidence:** the project's signing date, its sale channel and the date the cancellation request was recorded, all as the system records them.

## What a timely cancellation does

Within the period:

- every charge on the project is credited in full by a cancellation credit naming that charge;
- no cancellation fee is charged;
- every payment is refunded — the lender's disbursement to the lender, and every other payment to the method it came from.

## Contracts not signed at home

A contract signed in the showroom or by phone or web carries no statutory cancellation period; its cancellation follows the rules for cancellation after the cancellation period from the day it is signed.

## Ordering of equipment

Equipment is not ordered and no installation is scheduled before an in-home contract's cancellation period has ended.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, no federal public holiday in the count)

| Signed (in-home) | Business days counted | Last timely day | Notice on | Timely |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Tue (1), Wed (2), Thu (3) | Thursday, to the end of the day | Thursday evening | Yes |
| Monday | Tue (1), Wed (2), Thu (3) | Thursday | Friday | No |
| Thursday | Fri (1), Sat (2), Sun not counted, Mon (3) | Monday | Monday | Yes |
| Thursday | Fri (1), Sat (2), Mon (3) | Monday | Tuesday | No |

Saturday is a business day under this count; only Sundays and federal public holidays are skipped. A federal public holiday inside the count is skipped in the same way as a Sunday.
